tips.text: Hold Decimating Smash for over a second before you release it. Then the enemy is knocked up and stunned, and not just slowed.
Hit the enemy with Roar of the Slayer first, then charge Decimating Smash. The slow makes the long charge much easier to land.
Cast Soul Furnace before a trade to take less damage. Recast it once the shield has held a while to damage nearby enemies.
Watch the shield amount shown on the Soul Furnace buff. Recast it before the shield breaks so the explosion still goes off.
Last-hit minions and take kills with Soul Furnace to grow your max Health. Large minions and champion takedowns give more.
Aim Unstoppable Onslaught down a straight path. You can barely turn, so line it up with the enemy before you start.
Run a long way with Unstoppable Onslaught before you hit someone. The farther you travel, the longer the stun and the bigger the damage.
If you die in a fight, keep attacking. Glory in Death makes you hit very fast and heal, so go for the nearest enemy.

combos.name: Minion bounce E
combos.when: In lane when enemy minions stand between you and the enemy champion.
combos.text: Aim the shockwave at a minion. It is knocked back into the enemy behind it, who takes the same damage, slow and armor shred.

combos.name: Slow into smash
combos.when: When you want to land a fully charged stun on a laner who would otherwise walk out of it.
combos.text: Hit the shockwave first so the slow gives you time to charge the smash past one second. Release when the axe flashes for the stun.

combos.name: Shield pop
combos.when: When trading in melee range and the shield is still up after a few seconds.
combos.text: Cast the shield, then recast after three seconds while it still holds to detonate it. Check the shield amount on your buff icon to time the pop.

tips.text: Walk through Aatrox's Darkin Blade by moving sideways, then trade back with Roar of the Slayer while he is on cooldown.
Land Roar of the Slayer first so the enemy is slowed, then charge Decimating Smash to stun them.
Break the chain from Infernal Chains by walking toward Aatrox or to the side. Use Soul Furnace's shield if you get caught.
Let Soul Furnace's shield hold a few seconds, then recast it when Aatrox is close to hit him for extra damage.
Start charging Decimating Smash when Akali is boxed in or walking up to trade; hold it for a full stun, because she can run out of a quick swing.
Fire Roar of the Slayer first so she is slowed, then land a charged Decimating Smash on her.
Cast Soul Furnace when Akali is about to burst you, and detonate it once the shield has held for a while to hit her back.
Save Unstoppable Onslaught for when Akali is out of Twilight Shroud and in a straight line from you, since it turns only slightly.
If you die in a fight, keep attacking whoever is closest with Glory in Death. Akali's low health makes her a good target.
Start charging Decimating Smash when Ambessa is stuck in her own ability animations; if she dashes away with Drakehound's Step, release early to still slow her.
Fire Roar of the Slayer first so she is slowed, then land a fully charged Decimating Smash on her.
Cast Soul Furnace before she trades with you. Hold the shield for the recast and blow it up on her once it has held a while.
Watch for her Repudiation shield. Her slam hits harder if she was hit during the brace, so back out of range after you hit her.
Step back when Lacerate comes out; she can spin a second time after her dash. Trade back while her Lacerate is on cooldown.
If she kills you, use your frenzy from Glory in Death to hit her. Public Execution can still grab you, so stay close to her.
Hold Decimating Smash charge for a full second or more when Anivia is near; she gets knocked up and stunned, and you can follow with Roar of the Slayer.
Sidestep Flash Frost, then walk up and trade. Anivia has little to stop you once it is gone.
Fight when Anivia's Flash Frost is on cooldown, because it is her main tool for slowing and stunning you.
Use Soul Furnace for a shield before trading with Anivia's spells, and recast it once the shield has held for a while to deal damage.
Don't chase Anivia through Glacial Storm. It slows you and hurts a lot once fully formed.
If you kill Anivia, her egg comes back unless you also kill it. Hit it quickly.
Aim Roar of the Slayer first so the enemy is slowed, then hold Decimating Smash for a long charge. A full charge stuns for longer.
Be careful when you start charging Decimating Smash while Aurora is near. She can hop away with Across the Veil and vanish from your aim.
Use Soul Furnace to absorb her magic poke, and detonate it once the shield has held a while to hurt her if she stays close.
Do not run into her Between Worlds ring. Enemies who touch its edge are slowed, and she can hop across it.
Save Unstoppable Onslaught for when she has used Across the Veil. Charge in a straight line, since you can barely turn.
Charge Decimating Smash past the halfway point before you release it; a short charge only slows Briar and does not stun her.
Hit Briar with Roar of the Slayer first; she is slowed and easier to catch with a full Decimating Smash.
Use Soul Furnace when Briar jumps on you, then let it blow up once the shield has held for a while.
Briar can still be stunned when she leaps in with Head Rush, so keep Decimating Smash ready to punish her landing.
Do not die with Briar nearby in a fight; Glory in Death makes you fast and strong, but she can still outlast you if she heals up.
Charge Decimating Smash past its first second when Camille is stuck or slowed; a full charge stuns her for a long time. A quick tap only slows her.
Hit Camille with Roar of the Slayer before you charge Decimating Smash. It slows her and cuts her Armor, so she can't easily step out of the slam.
Cast Soul Furnace when Camille starts a trade. Hold the shield for a while, then recast to detonate it on her.
Camille's Hookshot dash and Hextech Ultimatum are her ways in. Stay away from walls and keep your shield ready when she has them.
Aim Unstoppable Onslaught in a straight line, because it barely turns. Camille's slow from Tactical Sweep won't stop it.
Step out of the Rupture area as soon as you see the smoke cloud; being knocked up there sets up Cho'Gath's next ability.
Stay out of Feral Scream range, which is short. Being silenced stops you from using your abilities.
Use Roar of the Slayer to slow Cho'Gath, then land Decimating Smash on him while he is slowed.
Use Soul Furnace for a shield before trading with Cho'Gath, and detonate it once it has held a while.
Keep Cho'Gath from eating minions and growing; deny his Feast stacks by pushing the wave and fighting him early.
Hold Decimating Smash until Darius is close, and charge it behind a minion wave or after Roar of the Slayer slows him, so he can't just walk out.
Open the fight with Roar of the Slayer. It slows Darius and cuts his Armor, which sets up a full Decimating Smash.
Cast Soul Furnace just before Darius gets on you, so the shield soaks his bleed damage. Recast it once the shield has held for a while to damage him.
Stay out of Apprehend's cone. If he pulls you in, you are knocked up and slowed, and you can't charge Decimating Smash while he trades.
Don't stand and trade once Darius has stacked bleeds on you. Back off, because his Noxian Guillotine hurts more the more stacks you carry.
If you die, Glory in Death lets you keep fighting for a moment. Chase Darius while it lasts, since your attacks are very fast and heal you.
Charge Decimating Smash past its first second before you release it, so Dr. Mundo is knocked up and stunned for a real window. A quick tap only slows him.
Dr. Mundo resists the first immobilizing effect, so bait it with a cheap one. Land your full Decimating Smash after the passive is used up.
Hit Dr. Mundo with Roar of the Slayer before his bonesaw trades. He is slowed and loses Armor, and the shockwave passes through units, so it is easy to land.
Use Soul Furnace to soak his Infected Bonesaw and Heart Zapper damage. Detonate it when he is close, since it hits for a share of his max Health.
Do not trade into Maximum Dosage; he heals through it. Back off and wait for the effect to wear off.
Don't start Decimating Smash while Fiora's Riposte is ready. She parries the stun and stabs you with it, so wait until she has used it.
Hit Fiora with Roar of the Slayer first. It slows her and cuts her Armor, which sets up a Decimating Smash that lands.
Cast Soul Furnace when Fiora walks up to trade. Hold the shield, then recast to blast her if it is still up.
Don't chase Fiora with Unstoppable Onslaught. Her Riposte can answer it, and you can't steer the charge much.
Hold Decimating Smash charging until Gangplank is stuck in place or walking into you; a full charge stuns him for a long time.
Land Roar of the Slayer first so he is slowed, then follow with Decimating Smash while he cannot step out of the area.
Do not rely on stunning him when Remove Scurvy is ready; it removes crowd control. Bait it out, then commit.
Use Soul Furnace as a shield before he trades with kegs, and recast it to hit him if the shield holds.
Stay out of keg range when he has several stocked; fight when he has few, and step away from lit kegs.
Walk up and attack his kegs to defuse them before he can blow them up.
At level 6, Unstoppable Onslaught in a straight line lets you reach him through slows and stun him on arrival.
Charge Decimating Smash past the halfway point so Garen is knocked up and stunned. Hold it longer when he is walking into you.
Hit Garen with Roar of the Slayer first so he is slowed and loses Armor, then follow with a charged Decimating Smash.
Expect Garen to be silenced-proof against your slows: his Decisive Strike removes slows from him, so do not count on Roar of the Slayer to hold him.
Pop Soul Furnace when Garen steps in to trade. Hold the shield for a few seconds, then recast it to hit him.
Do not fight him at low health. Demacian Justice finishes you quickly, though Glory in Death gives you one more chance to fight back.
Hold Decimating Smash until Gnar is close, then release it after a short charge; a full charge is easy to see and step out of.
Land Roar of the Slayer first so Gnar is slowed, then follow with a charged Decimating Smash that he can't walk out of.
Gnar outranges you, so use Soul Furnace for the shield when he starts poking, then detonate it once he walks into you.
Fight Mega Gnar with care: Decimating Smash stuns him if you charge long enough, which can stop him from throwing you.
Stay away from walls when Gnar is Mega; his ultimate stuns you if it throws you into one.
When Gnar shrinks and is tired, he can't gain Rage for a while, so that is your window to push and trade.
Hold Decimating Smash for a full charge before releasing, because a long charge stuns for longer. Gragas can still dodge it, so aim it where he is walking.
Land Roar of the Slayer first so Gragas is slowed, then follow with Decimating Smash. He will struggle to step out of it.
Cast Soul Furnace before Gragas trades with you, then recast it after the shield has held a while to hit him back.
Do not chase Gragas after he uses Body Slam. It comes back quickly, so he can stun you when you overextend.
Hit Gragas with Roar of the Slayer when he rolls Barrel Roll toward you. It slows him and reduces his Armor, so you win the trade.
Hold Decimating Smash for a full charge only when Gwen can't easily step out of it; a short charge only slows her and is easy to dodge.
Hit Gwen with Roar of the Slayer first; it slows her so a charged Decimating Smash is much harder to escape.
Don't waste abilities on Gwen while she stands in Hallowed Mist; she can't be targeted from outside it. Wait for it to end or fight her inside it.
Use Soul Furnace as a shield before trading with Gwen, and detonate it once it has held a while to hit her with magic damage.
Gwen needs a few attacks to build her damage, so start the fight first and don't let her walk up freely.
Hit Heimerdinger with Roar of the Slayer before you charge Decimating Smash; it leaves him slowed so the stun is easier to land.
Open Soul Furnace before you walk into his Hextech Micro-Rockets range; the shield soaks the poke and then explodes on him.
Do not stand still inside the circle of his turrets; fight him away from them or wait until they are gone.
Use Unstoppable Onslaught to run him down once he has thrown his grenade; Sion keeps charging through slows.
Hold Decimating Smash for a longer charge; it stuns for longer. Fire Roar of the Slayer first so the enemy is slowed and easier to hit.
Fight away from Illaoi's Tentacles. Hit the Tentacles when you can, since she is much weaker without them.
Use Soul Furnace's shield when Illaoi's Tentacles or Harsh Lesson are about to land. Recast it once the shield has held, to hurt her.
If Illaoi pulls out your spirit with Test of Spirit, hit her. Damaging her shortens the spirit's life.
Use Unstoppable Onslaught to chase her down or to close a fight, in a straight line, since you can barely turn.
Hold Decimating Smash for a full charge only when Irelia can't reach you. She can dash in with Bladesurge before the stun lands.
Land Roar of the Slayer first so she is slowed, then follow with a charged Decimating Smash.
Don't waste Decimating Smash on Defiant Dance. She takes less damage and can't be stopped while charging, so wait until she releases.
Fight her away from the minion wave. Without minions to dash through, Irelia is much easier to catch and punish.
Cast Soul Furnace when she is about to trade. Let the shield absorb her damage, then recast it to hit her.
Use Unstoppable Onslaught from far away so she can't easily stop it. Steer in a straight line toward her.
Walk out of melee range while Jax is in Counter Strike; it dodges your basic attacks and stuns you when it ends. Attack after it finishes.
Land Roar of the Slayer first; it leaves Jax slowed, which makes Decimating Smash much easier to land.
Hold the charge of Decimating Smash for a full hit only when Jax cannot easily jump out. A longer charge stuns for longer.
Use Soul Furnace's shield before a trade. Pop it for damage once it has held a while.
Do not fight long toe-to-toe with Jax. His attack speed keeps building, so trade in short bursts and step back.
Land Roar of the Slayer first so Jayce is slowed, then hold Decimating Smash for a full charge. The long stun is hard for him to escape.
Jayce can hit you from range with Shock Blast. Cast Soul Furnace when you see it coming so the shield soaks the damage.
Don't start charging Decimating Smash when Jayce is in Hammer form next to you. Thundering Blow knocks you back and ruins the charge.
Jayce is strongest early, so farm safely and trade only when your shield is up. Soul Furnace also grows your Health with every kill.
Use Unstoppable Onslaught in a straight line toward Jayce once you have level 6. He is stunned if you reach him and slowed if you only get close.
Charge Decimating Smash past the first second before you release it. A full charge stuns K'Sante for much longer than a quick tap.
Land Roar of the Slayer first to slow K'Sante, then follow with Decimating Smash. He will struggle to walk out of the swing.
Use Soul Furnace as a shield when K'Sante walks up to trade. Recast it once the shield has held a while to hit him for bonus damage.
Do not start charging Decimating Smash when K'Sante can pull or stun you. A stun interrupts the charge and wastes the ability.
Hold Unstoppable Onslaught for a straight line to K'Sante. It turns poorly, and he can dodge it with a sidestep.
Hit Kayle hard before level 6. She is a weak melee champion until Divine Ascent gives her range.
Open with Roar of the Slayer to slow Kayle, then land a charged Decimating Smash on her.
Kayle is fragile. Once she can shoot from range, use Unstoppable Onslaught in a straight line to reach her.
Use Soul Furnace's shield when you trade with Kayle's Radiant Blast. Recast it to damage her once the shield has held a few seconds.
Kayle's Divine Judgment only stops damage. You can still stun or slow her, so wait out the invulnerability and hit her afterwards.
Walk at Kennen with Roar of the Slayer first, then follow with Decimating Smash; the slow makes the charged hit much easier to land.
Charge Decimating Smash for a full second or longer so the hit knocks Kennen up and stuns him. A quick tap only slows.
Use Soul Furnace for a shield before Kennen starts a trade. Recast it once the shield has held for a while to hit him with the blast.
Kennen is fragile. When he dashes in with Lightning Rush, turn and hit him instead of running.
Stay out of a straight line from Thundering Shuriken. It stops at the first enemy it hits, so keep a minion between you and him.
Hold Unstoppable Onslaught for a straight run at Kennen. He is a squishy target, and the stun and slow can set up a kill.
Walk up and charge Decimating Smash when Kled is busy with minions; held for at least a second it knocks him up and stuns him, so use it for a kill or trade.
Open with Roar of the Slayer so he is slowed, then land a charged Decimating Smash on him as he tries to close in.
Cast Soul Furnace before he jumps in with Violent Tendencies. The shield soaks his burst, and you can detonate it once it has held for a while.
Kled's Skaarl soaks damage, so trade for a while and wait until he drops off his mount. Then he hits you less hard and is easier to finish.
Stay out of the line of Bear Trap on a Rope, or stay far enough away that you can step out of the tether before he pulls you.
Start charging Decimating Smash when Malphite walks up, and let go after a full charge. Early release only slows him, so hold it for the stun.
Land Roar of the Slayer first so Malphite is slowed, then follow with a charged Decimating Smash.
Use Soul Furnace for a shield when Malphite starts a trade, then recast it once the shield has held a while to hurt him.
Malphite's Seismic Shard slows you and speeds him up, so don't chase him in a straight line. Wait for Roar of the Slayer to be ready first.
Aim Unstoppable Onslaught in a straight line at Malphite; you can barely turn while charging. Unstoppable Force can't be stopped by your stun.
Hold Roar of the Slayer until Mordekaiser steps in close, then follow with a full-charge Decimating Smash while he is slowed.
Don't trade while Mordekaiser's Darkness Rise aura is on; back off until it fades, then fight.
Sidestep Death's Grasp; it lands after a short delay, so move out of the claw before it closes.
Pop Soul Furnace when Mordekaiser commits, then recast it once the shield has held a while to hit him back.
Once Realm of Death takes you in, Glory in Death won't save you. You are cut off, so stay away from him at level 6.
Hold Decimating Smash for a full charge when Naafiri is stuck or low on space; the stun is long. Release early if she is about to dodge.
Open with Roar of the Slayer so she is slowed, then land Decimating Smash on her while she cannot get away.
Pop Soul Furnace when she dives in. The shield soaks her burst, and the blast hurts her if the shield survives.
Do not waste Decimating Smash while she is untargetable from The Call of the Pack. Wait until she lands.
Aim Unstoppable Onslaught in a straight line at her. It is hard to turn, and you stop when you hit her.
Charge Decimating Smash for at least a second when Nasus walks up to last-hit; the stun gives you a free trade, and a short charge only slows him.
Fire Roar of the Slayer first so he is slowed, then land a full Decimating Smash on him.
Trade early and push him off last hits, before Siphoning Strike has grown strong from his farm.
Use Roar of the Slayer on minions to hit Nasus behind them; it keeps going after a hit and cuts his Armor.
Cast Soul Furnace before he trades with you, then detonate it once the shield has held a while to hurt him.
Avoid fighting him while Fury of the Sands is active; use Unstoppable Onslaught to stun and slow him only when you can kill, or back off until it ends.
Stay out of Olaf's Undertow line and don't stand where his axe lands. Being slowed makes it easy for him to catch you.
Charge Decimating Smash for at least a moment before releasing. It then knocks Olaf up and stuns him, unless he has Ragnarok active.
Don't spend your stun or slow while Ragnarok is active. Olaf is immune to disables then, so wait for it to end.
Use Roar of the Slayer to slow Olaf and cut his Armor, then follow up with a charged Decimating Smash.
Olaf grows stronger the lower his health gets. Don't chase him when he is low, and don't leave him alive at a sliver.
Pop Soul Furnace for a shield when Olaf starts a trade. Recast it once the shield has held for a while to damage him.
Stay away from walls when Ornn is near. Searing Charge only stuns you if he hits terrain, so fight in open space.
Hold Decimating Smash for a full charge when Ornn stops to farm. He is stunned for longer the longer you charge.
Open with Roar of the Slayer, which slows him, then land a charged Decimating Smash while he is slowed.
Use Soul Furnace for a shield when Ornn walks up to trade. Recast it once the shield has held to hit him for bonus damage.
Step out of the way of Volcanic Rupture. Its pillar can block your path, so don't charge Decimating Smash where it lands.
Start charging Decimating Smash when Pantheon walks up to trade; held for a full charge it knocks him up and stuns him for a long time.
Hit Pantheon with Roar of the Slayer first so he is slowed, then follow with a charged Decimating Smash that is hard for him to dodge.
Do not hit Pantheon head-on while he braces with Aegis Assault; walk around behind him or wait for it to end.
Use Soul Furnace before Pantheon jumps on you; the shield soaks his burst, then recast it to blast him if the shield survives.
When Pantheon starts Grand Starfall, move out of the target area. It gives plenty of warning, and it is a good time to push the wave or shove him off.
Aim Roar of the Slayer first so the enemy is slowed, then charge Decimating Smash to land the stun. Quinn is hard to catch without that slow.
Hold the Decimating Smash charge past its first moment when you can. A long charge is what stuns, and Quinn will not stand still for it in the open.
Cast Soul Furnace when Quinn starts to trade. Hold the shield and detonate it once it has lasted long enough to hit her.
When Quinn uses Behind Enemy Lines to roam, push the wave and follow with Unstoppable Onslaught, or take the tower.
Her Blinding Assault shrinks your vision. Stay close to your minions, and don't charge Decimating Smash blind.
Stand just outside Renekton's reach and charge Decimating Smash; if it lands after a long charge, he is knocked up and stunned and you get a free trade.
Open with Roar of the Slayer to slow him, then follow with Decimating Smash so he cannot easily step out of it.
Cast Soul Furnace when Renekton walks up to trade; the shield soaks his hits, and you can recast it after a short wait to blow it up on him.
Do not fight him inside his Fury window. When his Ruthless Predator is ready with full Fury, it destroys your shield and stuns you for longer.
Charging Decimating Smash locks you in place, so do not start one while Slice and Dice is ready; he can dash in and stun you.
If you die in a fight, run at Renekton during Glory in Death; your fast attacks heal you and hit hard against his max Health.
Hold Decimating Smash charging until Riven is committed to a fight; a full charge stuns her for a long time, but she can dash out of the line first.
Hit Riven with Roar of the Slayer first; it leaves her slowed, which makes the following Decimating Smash much easier to land.
Cast Soul Furnace before Riven starts her combo; the shield soaks her burst and the detonation then hurts her if the shield survives.
Riven's damage is all physical and she can't heal, so trade when your shield is up and punish her after she spends her dashes.
If Riven kills you, run at her in Glory in Death; your fast attacks hit hard against her large health pool.
Charge Decimating Smash past the first second when Rumble is stuck in a trade; a full charge stuns him for a long time.
Open with Roar of the Slayer so Rumble is slowed, then land Decimating Smash on him while he can't easily step out.
Hit him once you see him Overheat. He can't cast spells then, so he can't stop your engage.
Use Soul Furnace when Rumble starts Flamespitter. The shield soaks his magic damage, and you can recast it to hit him back.
Don't stand in the fire of The Equalizer. Walk out of it, or fight him somewhere else.
Charge Decimating Smash past the halfway mark when Sett walks up to trade; a full charge stuns him for a long time, so aim where he will step.
Hit Sett with Roar of the Slayer first; it slows him, so the charged Decimating Smash is easier to land.
Cast Soul Furnace when Sett starts to trade. Pop it once the shield has held for a while, so he takes the blast as he stays in melee.
Don't let Sett pull you in with Facebreaker when he has enemies on both sides, such as a minion behind you. That lands a stun on you.
Sett stores damage as Grit for Haymaker, so a long trade lets him shield and hit back harder. Trade in short bursts and step out of the line.
Use Unstoppable Onslaught in a straight line toward Sett. You can't turn much, and it stops when you hit an enemy champion.
Hold Decimating Smash until Shen is boxed in; a full charge stuns him for a long time, but a quick release only slows him.
Open with Roar of the Slayer to slow Shen, then land Decimating Smash on him while he can't get away.
Pop Soul Furnace once its shield has absorbed damage from Shen's trade, then recast it to hit him.
Step out of the way of Shadow Dash. If Shen misses, he is open, so trade back hard.
Watch for Stand United at level 6; Shen can arrive in a side lane fight, so keep your Unstoppable Onslaught ready.
Hold Decimating Smash for a full charge when Singed is slowed or stuck in place. A short charge only slows him, and he can walk out of it.
Open with Roar of the Slayer to slow Singed, then land a charged Decimating Smash while he is slowed.
Don't chase Singed through his Poison Trail. Use Unstoppable Onslaught only when you can run in a straight line and hit him.
Use Soul Furnace for a shield before you walk into his poison, and recast it to hit him once the shield has held.
When Singed walks up to Fling you, hit him first with Roar of the Slayer. It slows him and lowers his Armor.
Charge Decimating Smash past its first moment and release it when Tahm Kench steps in to trade; a full charge stuns him for a long time.
Watch for Tahm Kench's Abyssal Dive channel. Smash him as he lands, or step away from the landing spot.
Open with Roar of the Slayer so he is slowed, then land Decimating Smash on him.
Trade when Tahm Kench has used his Thick Skin shield, since he skips the healing. Pile on damage while it is gone.
Do not rely on one lone poke. Tahm Kench heals from Tongue Lash and Thick Skin, so wait for a Smash to land.
Hold Decimating Smash charge until Teemo walks into range; a full charge stuns him for a long time and lets you hit him freely.
Open with Roar of the Slayer so Teemo is slowed, then land Decimating Smash on him while he can't easily step away.
Use Soul Furnace for a shield before trading with Teemo, and recast it once the shield has held a while to damage him.
Keep Soul Furnace shield up when you are poisoned and Teemo trades; it soaks his magic damage.
Last-hit minions with Soul Furnace ready; kills raise your max Health over time, which makes his poke weaker against you.
Avoid walking into brush or unwatched ground where Teemo may be hidden; his mushrooms slow and reveal you.
Charge Decimating Smash past the halfway point before you release it. Tryndamere has to stay close to you, so the stun is easy to land when he walks in.
Hit Tryndamere with Roar of the Slayer first. He is slowed, which makes the full Decimating Smash much easier to land.
Trade with Tryndamere while he is low on Fury. He heals back with Bloodlust once he has built it up.
Use Soul Furnace for a shield when Tryndamere dashes in. Recast it once the shield is still up to deal damage to him.
Don't spend everything on Tryndamere when Undying Rage is up. He cannot die for a few seconds, so back off and come back when it ends.
Charge Decimating Smash at Urgot only when he can't dodge. Fire Roar of the Slayer first so he is slowed.
Cast Soul Furnace before Urgot starts shooting, so its shield absorbs the damage. Detonate it when he is next to you.
Walk away when Urgot's Disdain is ready. It stuns you and throws you behind him.
Stay above the low-health line if Fear Beyond Death hits you; below it, Urgot can drag you in and execute you.
Hold Decimating Smash for a full charge when Varus is rooted, stuck in a fight or standing still. A fast tap only slows him and he can walk out of it.
Hit Varus with Roar of the Slayer first. It slows him and cuts his Armor, which makes a charged Decimating Smash much easier to land.
Step in when Varus is charging Piercing Arrow. He moves slowly while charging and cannot cast Hail of Arrows or Chain of Corruption.
Cast Soul Furnace before you walk into his poke. The shield absorbs the damage, and you can recast it to hit him back.
Do not trade when he has a Blight stack on you. His abilities will pop it for extra damage.
Do not stand in the ground left by Hail of Arrows. It slows you and cuts your healing.
Charge Decimating Smash past its first second when Vayne is near a wall or trapped by minions; she is stunned for a long time and has no way to escape it.
Land Roar of the Slayer first so Vayne is slowed, then follow with Decimating Smash; she can't easily Tumble out of the charge area.
Use Soul Furnace's shield before Vayne's third attack lands. It soaks the damage and then blasts her based on her max Health.
At level 6, run her down with Unstoppable Onslaught when she is out of position. It stops on her and stuns her.
Stay away from walls when you fight her, or Condemn will pin you.
Release Decimating Smash after a long charge only when Vladimir cannot step aside. Land Roar of the Slayer first to slow him.
Wait for Vladimir to use Sanguine Pool before you commit Unstoppable Onslaught; it makes him untargetable.
Use Soul Furnace for a shield before his trades, then recast it once the shield has held for a while to damage him.
Do not fight Vladimir after he lands Hemoplague; he heals when it bursts. Back off until it ends.
Hold Decimating Smash until you have charged past the first second, so it knocks up and stuns. Release early only if Volibear is about to leave range.
Open with Roar of the Slayer so Volibear is slowed, then land a charged Decimating Smash on him.
Use Soul Furnace as a shield when Volibear dives in, and recast it once the shield has held for a while to damage him.
Do not charge Decimating Smash in the open when Volibear is close. If his Thundering Smash stuns you, you lose the charge.
Fight in lane when The Relentless Storm is low; Volibear gets much stronger once he lands several hits in a row.
Hold Decimating Smash until Xin Zhao is stuck in a fight or walks up to you; a long charge stuns him.
Use Roar of the Slayer first to slow Xin Zhao, then land Decimating Smash on him.
Cast Soul Furnace when Xin Zhao dashes in with Audacious Charge; the shield soaks his trade.
Watch Xin Zhao's third attack; Three Talon Strike knocks you up, so don't stand and trade when he's lined up for it.
Aim Roar of the Slayer first to slow Yasuo, then hold Decimating Smash for the full charge so the stun lands.
Yasuo's Wind Wall blocks Roar of the Slayer. Wait until it fades before you throw it.
Decimating Smash is not a projectile, so Wind Wall cannot stop it. Use it when Yasuo puts his wall up.
Yasuo can dash through minions with Sweeping Blade to dodge your charge. Wait until he has no minion or enemy nearby to dash through.
Use Soul Furnace before Yasuo trades with you, then recast it once the shield has held for a while to hit him.
Yasuo's knock-up from Steel Tempest lets him use Last Breath. Stay away from his allies' knock-ups when you fight near them.
Charge Unstoppable Onslaught in a straight line at Yasuo. It cannot be stopped, but you only turn slightly.
Aim Roar of the Slayer first so Yone is slowed, then hold Decimating Smash for a full charge. A fully charged hit stuns him for a long time.
Cast Soul Furnace when Yone walks up to trade. Keep the shield up for a while, then recast to blast him for damage based on his max Health.
Yone's Fate Sealed can pull you in and knock you down. Stay near your minions and tower so a kill on you costs him.
Yone can dash back with Soul Unbound after trading. Don't chase him into a long fight; use Roar of the Slayer from range instead.
Use Unstoppable Onslaught in a straight line toward Yone. It stuns him if you charge a long way, and you can't be stopped on the way in.
Aim Decimating Smash at Yorick after he commits a Dark Procession or a Mist Walker push, and hold the charge for a longer stun.
Use Roar of the Slayer first to leave Yorick slowed, then follow with a charged Decimating Smash that is harder to dodge.
Hit Yorick's Mist Walkers with Roar of the Slayer; the shockwave keeps going through them and it hurts every enemy it passes.
Use Soul Furnace to absorb Yorick's trades, then recast it after the shield has held a while to hurt him and his Mist Walkers.
Kill the Maiden of the Mist before you fight Yorick; she adds a lot to his damage.
Hold Decimating Smash for a full charge when Zaahen is stuck in a fight or walking up to trade; a long charge knocks him up and stuns him.
Fire Roar of the Slayer first so Zaahen is slowed, then land your Decimating Smash on him.
Pop Soul Furnace before Zaahen's burst, then recast it once the shield has held a while to hit him back.
Don't stand at long range in a straight line from Zaahen; Dreaded Return pulls you in. Keep a minion between you or sidestep it.
Zaahen can come back from death when his stacks are full, so back off and let them fade before you try to finish him.
